groups.label: Apps
groups.blurb: Full constellation apps — install, update, open, remove.

groups.label: Libs
groups.blurb: One APK per library module, installable and inspectable on its own. Most are also compiled into the apps that use them. Two are not: net-wg (WireGuard), an out-of-process engine its app needs installed, and the two rootfs libraries — the ~400 MB root filesystems the terminals enter (#628). Those two are large, and they are ordinary: the store installs and updates them exactly like every other row here, and the terminal that needs one reads it out of the installed APK instead of downloading a runtime of its own.

groups.label: Lite-ML
groups.blurb: Lite-ML: mobile and desktop CPU models, roughly 5MB-50MB. Real modules install like any lib and are engines the keyboard needs installed. Reference rows have nothing to install; Update all never fetches them.

groups.label: Tiny-ML
groups.blurb: Tiny-ML: extreme edge and microcontroller models, under about 2MB. Reference rows are third-party libraries with nothing to install; Update all never fetches them.
